features: POWERFUL DRIVER: Featuring a 10mm neodymium driver, these earphones are designed to deliver powerful sound with rich, deep bass performance.
COMFORT: Enjoy long listening sessions in comfort with these earphones, thanks to their lightweight, ergonomic design, perfect for all-day wear.
IN-EAR DESIGN: Designed with an ergonomic in-ear fit, these earphones provide excellent sound isolation along with superior comfort for extended use.
CRYSTAL-CLEAR AUDIO: Equipped with an in-line mic, these earphones deliver deep bass and clear voice capture for immersive music, calls, and virtual meetings.
CONNECTOR TYPE: Features a Type-C connector designed to work with smartphones and tablets that have a dedicated Type-C port.
